I was on my laptop so you were fucking me haha. However, the next night we were LFM and Robin Barney and I had a serious talk about members. I mentioned you and said that you had improved as I generally thought that. They then trialied you I believe, I'm not sure as I was in Spain and then you got in. I think you take my jokes too seriously but other than that, you're quite good and you're chill.
